title: Localize one core module (domain-qualified reviewer)
context: The curriculum's i18n-readiness (established in template-004) enables localization to serve cancer researchers who are not well-served by English-only materials. Localizing one core module proves the localization process, validates the i18n-readiness of the source material, and enables M3 success metric (>= 1 module localized via domain-qualified reviewer). The target module is preferably one of the M1 core modules (e.g., versioning-008) as it will have had an accessibility pass. Risk is medium because the worked example (if any) retains its data-gate requirement in the localized version. Depends on: template-004, versioning-008.
objective: Localize one core module (preferably versioning-008) into a target language using a domain-qualified translator/reviewer who is fluent in the target language and has cancer bioinformatics expertise; preserve CC-BY-4.0 attribution; confirm no i18n regressions in the source module.
acceptanceCriteria: One core module (e.g., versioning-008) fully localized into a target language: all text sections (objectives, lesson, exercise instructions, checklist, assessment, instructor notes) translated.
Domain-qualified reviewer fluent in the target language and with cancer bioinformatics expertise signs off on technical accuracy and appropriateness of terminology.
Educator reviewer confirms cognitive load, accessibility, and pedagogical structure are maintained in the translated version.

If the module contains a worked example with a cancer dataset, the data gate (datagate-002) still applies: the localized example must reference the same PASS gate artifact or a new one for any additional data used.
CC-BY-4.0 attribution is preserved and correct in the localized version; original authorship credited.

i18n-readiness of the source module confirmed: no locale-specific strings or assumptions introduced; localized module committed to the repo in a language-scoped directory (e.g., modules/es/ or modules/fr/); DCO signed off.
resources: PLAN.md (Goals — i18n-readiness; Sustainability — adoption beyond the authors)
WCAG 2.2 AA (applies equally to localized content)
output: A localized version of one core module committed to the project repo in a language-scoped directory, with domain-qualified reviewer and educator reviewer sign-offs; source module i18n-readiness confirmed.
